/* =========================================================
   第一步：先把三张表拼成评分底表(只统计今日的)
   目标：让每个 ASIN 只保留一行，后面的评分只看这张表
   ========================================================= */
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS score_base;
CREATE TABLE score_base AS
SELECT
    rp.asin,
    COALESCE(rp.title, bs.product_name) AS product_name,
    COALESCE(rp.price, bs.price) AS price,
    COALESCE(rp.brand, 'Unknown') AS brand,
    COALESCE(rp.category, 'Unknown') AS category,
    COALESCE(rp.crawl_date, bs.crawl_date) AS crawl_date,
    COALESCE(rp.image_url, bs.image_url) AS image_url,
    bs.bsr_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN bs.bsr_rank IS NULL THEN '未入榜'
        ELSE '已入榜'
    END AS bsr_status,
    COALESCE(bs.review_count, ra.review_count, 0) AS review_count,
    COALESCE(bs.rating, ra.avg_rating) AS rating
FROM raw_products rp
LEFT JOIN bsr_top50 bs
    ON rp.asin = bs.asin
    AND bs.crawl_date = CURDATE()          -- ← 改动①：只 JOIN 今天的榜单快照
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        asin,
        COUNT(*) AS review_count,
        ROUND(AVG(rate), 1) AS avg_rating
    FROM product_reviews
    WHERE crawl_date = CURDATE()           -- ← 改动②：只聚合今天的评论（如有 crawl_date 字段）
    GROUP BY asin
) ra
    ON rp.asin = ra.asin
WHERE rp.crawl_date = CURDATE();           -- ← 改动③：主表只取今天采集的商品

nodes.name: 节点 1：MySQL — 建评分底表 score_base

parameters.query:
/* =========================================================
   第二步：趋势热度分
   目标：先算出 BSR 子分、评论热度子分，再合成 trend_score
   规则：
   1) 已入榜：rank 越小，分越高；rank 1 = 100 分，rank 100 = 0 分
   2) 未入榜：给一个明显惩罚分 20 分，让它能参与评分但不和榜内商品平起平坐
   3) 评论数：用对数归一化，避免长尾数据把分数拉得过于夸张
   ========================================================= */
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS score_trend;
CREATE TABLE score_trend AS
SELECT
    b.*,

    /* BSR 子分：把 1~100 的排名映射到 0~100 分 */
    CASE
        WHEN bsr_rank BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN
            ROUND((100 - bsr_rank) / 99 * 100, 1)
        ELSE
            20.0
    END AS bsr_score,

    /* 评论热度子分：对数归一化，评论数越多分越高，但增长会越来越慢 */
    ROUND(
        LEAST(LOG10(review_count + 1) / LOG10(10000) * 100, 100),
        1
    ) AS review_score,

    /* 趋势热度综合分：BSR 占 60%，评论热度占 40% */
    ROUND(
        (
            CASE
                WHEN bsr_rank BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN
                    ROUND((100 - bsr_rank) / 99 * 100, 1)
                ELSE
                    20.0
            END
        ) * 0.6
        + LEAST(LOG10(review_count + 1) / LOG10(10000) * 100, 100) * 0.4,
        1
    ) AS trend_score
FROM score_base b;

nodes.name: 节点 2：MySQL — 建趋势热度分表 score_trend

parameters.query:
/* =========================================================
   第三步：竞争度分
   目标：评论越多，市场越拥挤，所以竞争度分越低
   处理方法：线性反向计分 + GREATEST 保底到 0
   ========================================================= */
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS score_competition;
CREATE TABLE score_competition AS
SELECT
    t.*,

    /*
      逻辑解释：
      - review_count = 0 时，competition_score 接近 100
      - review_count = 5000 时，competition_score 接近 0
      - 如果算出来是负数，就用 GREATEST 强制拉回 0
    */
    ROUND(
        GREATEST(100 - (review_count / 5000.0) * 100, 0),
        1
    ) AS competition_score
FROM score_trend t;

nodes.name: 节点 3：MySQL — 建竞争度分表 score_competition

parameters.query:
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS score_profit;
CREATE TABLE score_profit AS
SELECT
    x.*,
    CASE
        WHEN x.price IS NULL OR x.price <= 0 THEN 0
        WHEN x.price < 80  THEN 20
        WHEN x.price < 150 THEN 60
        WHEN x.price < 300 THEN 100
        WHEN x.price < 500 THEN 70
        ELSE 40
    END AS profit_score
FROM (
    SELECT
        t.asin,
        t.product_name,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(rp.price, 0), NULLIF(bs.price, 0), 0) AS price,
        t.brand,
        t.category,
        t.crawl_date,
        t.image_url,
        t.bsr_rank,
        t.bsr_status,
        t.review_count,
        t.rating,
        t.bsr_score,
        t.review_score,
        t.trend_score,
        t.competition_score
    FROM score_competition t
    LEFT JOIN raw_products rp
        ON t.asin = rp.asin
        AND rp.crawl_date = CURDATE()      -- ← 加这行
    LEFT JOIN bsr_top50 bs
        ON t.asin = bs.asin
        AND bs.crawl_date = CURDATE()      -- ← 加这行
) x;

nodes.name: 节点 4：MySQL — 建利润空间分表 score_profit

parameters.query:
/* =========================================================
   先把前三维的结果整理进 product_scores
   说明：
   - rule_score_80 = 趋势热度 30% + 竞争度 25% + 利润空间 25%
   - risk_score 先留空，等 LLM 风险结果回来后再写入
   - total_score 也先留空，最后一步统一计算
   ========================================================= */
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS product_scores;
CREATE TABLE product_scores AS
SELECT
    asin,
    product_name,
    brand,
    category,
    price,
 /* 价格档位：从一次性 GROUP BY 升级为商品的固有属性 */
    CASE
        WHEN price < 150 THEN '$0-150（低端）'
        WHEN price < 250 THEN '$150-250（中低端）'
        WHEN price < 400 THEN '$250-400（中端）'
        WHEN price < 600 THEN '$400-600（中高端）'
        ELSE '$600+（高端）'
    END AS price_band,
    crawl_date,
    bsr_rank,
    bsr_status,
    review_count,
    rating,
    bsr_score,
    review_score,
    trend_score, -- 趋势热度分
    competition_score, -- 竞争度分
    profit_score, -- 利润空间分

    /* 三个规则维度的合成分：满分 80 */
    ROUND(
        trend_score * 0.30
        + competition_score * 0.25
        + profit_score * 0.25,
        1
    ) AS rule_score_80,

    NULL AS risk_score,
    NULL AS risk_summary,
    NULL AS total_score
FROM score_profit;

ALTER TABLE product_scores
MODIFY COLUMN rule_score_80 DECIMAL(10,1) NULL,
MODIFY COLUMN risk_score DECIMAL(10,1) NULL,
MODIFY COLUMN risk_summary TEXT NULL,
MODIFY COLUMN total_score DECIMAL(10,1) NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       SUM(rule_score_80 IS NOT NULL) AS rule_filled,
       SUM(risk_score IS NULL)        AS risk_pending
FROM product_scores;
